sloka: इन्द्रियार्थैः अभिमतैः नरचित्त प्रमाथिभि ।पुरम् आनाययिष्यामः क्षिप्रम् च अध्यवसीयताम् ॥१-१०-४॥
transliteration: indriyārthaiḥ abhimataiḥ naracitta pramāthibhi ।puram ānāyayiṣyāmaḥ kṣipram ca adhyavasīyatām ॥1-10-4॥

translations.english: By means of such things that can cause sensual pleasures and overpower the minds of men, we shall be able to bring him to the town. Let it be decided quickly (said the ministers)
